verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client and key manager, not a source-control tool, so commit signing falls outside its product category. Its SSH key generation and storage concern authenticating to servers, and nothing in the evidence shows Termius signing git commits or providing a signing agent, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sign my commits with a GPG or SSH key for verification
